optionReasons.dea-ini-034:option:0: S3 Inventory list objects and metadata — does not block public exposure.
optionReasons.dea-ini-034:option:1: It is the closest because Versioning is data protection resource of S3 — but it keeps VERSIONS for exclusion/overwritten recovery, does not prevent PUBLIC EXPOSURE; blocking public access by mistake at the account level/bucket is the S3 Block Public Access.
optionReasons.dea-ini-034:option:3: Intelligent-Tiering optimizes cost by access pattern — has no relation to public access.

finalJustifications: Because S3 Block Public Access prevents any data from being publicly exposed by mistake — the wrong configuration lock against leak.
Because S3 Versioning prevents any data from being publicly exposed by mistake at the account or pocket level — the wrong configuration lock against leak.
Because S3 Inventory prevents any data lake data from being exposed publicly by mistake — the lock against leak by wrong configuration.
Because S3 Intelligent-Tiering prevents any data from being publicly exposed by mistake — the wrong configuration lock against leak.
